name: ACU Alumni Tuition Discount
description: ACU bachelor's and master's alumni may receive 20% off eligible online graduate tuition. For an online social work master's, applicants without a BSW should review the standard MSSW path. Fees and field-placement costs are separate. This is a tuition reduction, not cash.

funding.amountDescription: 20% off eligible graduate tuition; fees excluded.
funding.applicationCycle: Request alumni eligibility confirmation for the intended term.
funding.stackingPolicy: Cannot combine with other ACU institutional scholarships or tuition discounts. Confirm external-award treatment with ACU. Terms: https://acu.edu/admissions-aid/online/financial-aid/online-scholarships/
funding.nextStep: Request a written tuition estimate for the standard online social-work master's, with the alumni discount applied. Confirm fees, field-placement costs, and how outside awards affect the total.

name: P.E.O. Program for Continuing Education Grant
description: One-time need-based grant of up to $4,000 for women returning to education after at least 24 consecutive months away. Applicants must already be in an eligible program, be within 18 months of completion, and receive a local chapter recommendation. An existing master's or doctorate excludes eligibility; a first master's may qualify. The program must improve employment prospects. Online study is explicitly allowed in the August 2026 policy.

other_requirements: Living and studying in the United States or Canada.
Accredited program must improve marketable employment skills; prerequisites and doctoral study are excluded.
No immediate continuation of education beyond the program for which the grant is requested.

funding.amountDescription: One-time award of up to $4,000; amount depends on documented need.
funding.applicationCycle: Rolling. Chapter recommendation must arrive 4-10 weeks before the term being funded; program must already have begun.
funding.fundingTiming: For a current program within 18 months of completion.
funding.stackingPolicy: Report other aid; award is based on remaining eligible educational need.
funding.nextStep: Check your education gap and expected completion date. Once enrolled and within 18 months of finishing, use the provider's potential-sponsorship form to request a local chapter review.

name: Consuelo W. Gosnell Memorial Scholarship
description: MSW scholarship recognizing commitment to American Indian/Alaska Native and Hispanic/Latino communities or work with public/voluntary nonprofit agencies and grassroots groups. The published ceiling is up to $5,000; next-cycle details need confirmation.

other_requirements: Applied to or accepted into a CSWE-accredited MSW program.
Demonstrated commitment to the named communities, public/voluntary nonprofit agencies, or grassroots groups.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.applicationCycle: 2026-2027 awards allocated. The 2027-2028 application cycle opens in January 2027; exact closing date and final amounts need confirmation.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Published award ceiling up to $5,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Track the next application cycle on the NASW Foundation page. Confirm NASW membership, program accreditation, GPA, and evidence of your work with the named communities or agencies.

name: Verne LaMarr Lyons Memorial Scholarship
description: MSW funding for students with demonstrated interest in or experience with health and mental-health practice, with a commitment to work in African American communities. The prior published award was $4,000; availability and next-cycle amount require confirmation.

other_requirements: CSWE-accredited MSW program.
Interest or experience in health/mental-health practice and commitment to African American communities.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.applicationCycle: 2026-2027 awards allocated. The 2027-2028 application cycle opens in January 2027; exact closing date and final amounts need confirmation.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Prior published award: $4,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Track the next NASW cycle and gather evidence of your health or mental-health experience and service goals. Confirm membership, program accreditation, and GPA requirements.

name: Lawanna Renee Barron Scholarship
description: BSW/MSW scholarship for students with an interest in serving rural communities and/or addressing mental-health needs in African American communities. The prior published award was $2,000; next-cycle amount requires confirmation.

other_requirements: CSWE-accredited BSW or MSW program.
Interest in rural communities and/or mental-health needs in African American communities.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.applicationCycle: 2026-2027 awards allocated. The 2027-2028 application cycle opens in January 2027; exact closing date and final amounts need confirmation.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm other-aid and school packaging rules with the provider.
funding.amountDescription: Prior published award: $2,000; next-cycle amount unconfirmed.
funding.nextStep: Check the next NASW cycle and prepare examples of rural-community service or African American mental-health work. Confirm membership, program accreditation, and GPA requirements.

name: UTA Title IV-E MSW Stipend
description: School-specific MSW child-welfare stipend. Published MSW stipend is $7,050 with qualifying employment obligations. This is an alternative-school opportunity; it cannot fund ACU or GCU study. Applicants must confirm placement and online-program compatibility.

other_requirements: Eligible child-welfare specialization and advanced block placement.
Apply in the semester before the eligible block placement.
Confirm online-program and practicum compatibility with the Title IV-E program.

funding.amountDescription: Published MSW stipend $7,050, subject to program selection and contract.
funding.applicationCycle: Placement-specific application timing; confirm current cohort availability.
funding.serviceObligation: Eight months of qualifying employment per stipend received; review the agreement and repayment consequences before accepting.
funding.stackingPolicy: Confirm stipend and other-aid interactions with UTA.
funding.nextStep: Consider this route only if UTA is a school option. Review the employment and repayment agreement, and ask the program about the application deadline before your planned practicum semester.

name: ACU Corporate Partner Tuition Discount
description: Employees of ACU corporate partners can receive a 10% online tuition reduction and an application-fee waiver. Verify the employer agreement and program coverage. ACU alumni should compare the separate alumni discount before selecting a benefit.

other_requirements: Current employment with an eligible ACU corporate partner and applicable program coverage must be confirmed by ACU.

funding.amountDescription: 10% reduction on eligible online tuition; application fee waived.
funding.stackingPolicy: Do not add this to the alumni discount. Request written confirmation of which benefit applies and whether outside awards can combine.
funding.nextStep: Give ACU the employer name and intended program. Request written confirmation of the partner benefit and compare the resulting total with the alumni offer.

name: GCU Employer and Organization Alliance Scholarships
description: GCU publishes tuition-support opportunities through employer and organization alliances for online learners. This is a route to investigate, not a guaranteed MSW award. The specific agreement determines eligibility and the discount.

other_requirements: GCU must confirm an eligible employer or organization alliance, applicant relationship, intended program and study format, start term, and scholarship amount.

funding.amountDescription: Agreement-specific tuition support; no MSW amount confirmed.
funding.applicationCycle: Request the current alliance terms for the intended starting term.
funding.fundingTiming: Confirm with GCU before accepting an offer.
funding.stackingPolicy: Request a written estimate explaining institutional discounts, outside awards, fees, and any exclusions.
funding.nextStep: Ask GCU to check applicable employer and organization alliances for the online MSW. Request the exact agreement, eligible program, discount, and full net-cost estimate in writing.

other: GCU confirmation of the applicable alliance agreement

name: Neysa Fanwick Memorial Scholarship
description: NASW MSW scholarship with no published minimum GPA. Applicants must show social-justice and system-change commitment, health/mental-health experience, and explain financial need. The annual $5,000 award depends on fund earnings.

other_requirements: CSWE-accredited MSW program.
Social justice and system-change commitment, health/mental-health experience, and a financial-need statement.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $5,000; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: 2026-2027 awards allocated. The 2027-2028 application cycle opens in January 2027; exact closing date unannounced.
funding.nextStep: Prepare a financial-need statement and examples of relevant work or service. Check NASW membership, MSW accreditation and the January 2027 application announcement.

name: The Melanie Foundation Scholarship
description: One-year $2,500 scholarship for an enrolled mental-health graduate student. CSWE-accredited social-work programs are among the accepted programs. Recipients may compete again in a later year.

other_requirements: Currently enrolled in a U.S. mental-health graduate program accredited by an accepted agency; CSWE is explicitly included.
Relevant extracurricular, volunteer, research or career activities.
Two references, including one mental-health professional.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $2,500; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: Annual deadline March 5; next calendar occurrence March 5, 2027. A separate 2027 opening notice has not been posted.
funding.nextStep: Once enrolled, confirm the MSW program qualifies and prepare an essay and two references, including a mental-health professional.

name: AKA EAF Graduate Merit and Financial Need Scholarships
provider_name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Educational Advancement Foundation
description: Two application routes in one program: graduate merit (3.0 GPA) and financial need (2.5 GPA). Full-time graduate study and community service are required. Awards are open across backgrounds; only one general scholarship may be received.

other_requirements: Merit route requires at least 3.0 GPA; need route requires at least 2.5 GPA and documented financial need.
Community service and involvement required.
Merit applicants may use a fall acceptance letter; the need route requires current enrollment.
Only one general scholarship may be received; previous general-award recipients cannot receive another.
Published graduate guidance accepts online and accelerated study; confirm next-cycle terms.

funding.amountDescription: Provider has not published a confirmed amount for the next cycle.
funding.applicationCycle: Graduate applications are due August 15 each year; 2026 has closed. Track the 2027 cycle.
funding.nextStep: Choose the merit or financial-need route, check full-time enrollment and GPA, and assemble community-service evidence. Confirm the next award amount and application opening.

name: EWI Dallas ASIST Scholarship
description: Adult reentry scholarship explicitly accepting master's study. Local award amount varies. Only chapter winners can compete for a separate national award of $2,000-$10,000; that is not the Dallas award or a guaranteed addition.

other_requirements: Residence in Dallas, Collin, or Tarrant County, Texas.
Legal U.S. residence and qualifying financial, social or economic challenges.
Use of reentry or community resources is considered. Current employment is not required.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.amountDescription: Provider has not published a confirmed amount for the next cycle.
funding.applicationCycle: 2026 Dallas deadline was March 31. 2027 dates have not been published; national annual application season is January-March.
funding.nextStep: Check county eligibility and the next Dallas chapter application. Document educational goals, need and reentry resources; ask whether the exact online MSW is eligible.

name: AAUW San Antonio Graduate Scholarship
description: Local graduate scholarship, usually $2,000, for residents of eight San Antonio-area counties. Master's study is explicitly eligible. This is separate from AAUW's national certificate-only Career Development Grants.

other_requirements: Two years of residence in Atascosa, Bandera, Bexar, Comal, Guadalupe, Kendall, Medina, or Wilson County.
At least six semester credit hours, unconditional acceptance or enrollment, and community service.
Confirm eligibility of the exact online program; published rules do not explicitly address online delivery.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $2,000; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: 2026 applications closed February 1; 2027 dates are not yet published.
funding.nextStep: Check the two-year county residency requirement and confirm your online program and planned credit load. Prepare GPA, financial-need and community-service documentation.

name: Davis-Putter Scholarship Fund
description: Need-based grants of up to $15,000 annually for students already organizing in progressive movements. Graduate, undergraduate and eligible certificate/trade study can qualify. The 2025-2026 average was about $7,700. Organizing experience and financial need are essential.

other_requirements: Existing participation in progressive movement organizing is required; interest in a social-work career alone is insufficient.
Enrollment in an eligible U.S. postsecondary degree, certificate or trade/technical program.
Full-time and part-time study are eligible. Confirm the intended online program.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $15,000; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: Recurring application season January-April 1. The 2026 cycle is closed; a separate 2027 announcement is pending.
funding.nextStep: Pursue this only if you already have qualifying organizing experience. Prepare the organizing narrative, recommendations and financial documentation.

name: CSWE Master's Minority Fellowship Program
description: Final-year MSW fellowship supporting behavioral-health training. The stipend depends on federal funding; a $10,000 award is not confirmed for the next cycle. Current published rules do not restrict applicants by race. Online learners must account for required in-person training.

other_requirements: Final-year student in a CSWE-accredited MSW program; not a first-year traditional MSW award.
Mental-health/substance-use focus and an appropriate field placement.
Training participation, including at least one in-person training under the 2026 rules.
Federal funding restrictions and current fellowship rules must be checked.

funding.amountDescription: Provider has not published a confirmed amount for the next cycle.
funding.applicationCycle: 2027-2028 applications open March 2027; 2026-2027 applications closed May 11, 2026.
funding.nextStep: Plan for the final full-time MSW year. Confirm behavioral-health placement, citizenship, training attendance, funding restrictions and the two-year employment commitment.
funding.serviceObligation: Commit to seeking related mental-health/substance-use employment for at least two years after graduation; review current fellowship agreement.

name: CSWE Carl A. Scott Book Scholarship
description: Small book scholarship. The latest cycle awarded $500 to one BSW student and one MSW student. This is a later-stage watchlist opportunity while the next cycle's full rules are pending.

other_requirements: Commitment to racial, economic and environmental justice.
2027 full eligibility, online eligibility and application dates are not published. Earlier calls targeted students entering their final year; verify current rules.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $500; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: 2026 recipients have been selected. 2027 dates and full eligibility have not been posted.
funding.nextStep: Monitor CSWE's next call and check final-year, enrollment and online-program rules before applying.

name: Ima Hogg Scholarship
description: School-nominated $5,000 scholarship for eligible Texas MSW students pursuing mental-health careers in Texas. ACU had a 2026 recipient, but the recipient's study mode is not specified. GCU does not satisfy the Texas-based program requirement.

other_requirements: Texas-based accredited or pending-accreditation MSW program; Texas residence alone does not qualify an out-of-state program such as GCU.
Standard two-year MSW entering its second year, or entering a one-year advanced-standing program.
Commitment to a mental-health career in Texas.
ACU participates, but eligibility of its exact online cohort and program duration needs confirmation.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $5,000; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: 2026 recipients announced June 10. 2027 nomination dates are unannounced; each school manages its internal nomination process.
funding.nextStep: Ask the Texas MSW program about school nomination, financial need, second-year timing and whether the specific online cohort meets the two-year program rule.

name: Carolyn C. and Santos H. Hernandez Scholarship
description: UTA-specific MSW funding, approximately $1,000 depending on available funds. Preference includes first-generation students, single parents, students overcoming obstacles, and those whose education was interrupted. This award cannot fund ACU or GCU study.

other_requirements: Award availability and eligibility for the intended online MSW cohort must be confirmed with UTA.

funding.amountDescription: Latest published award: $1,000; next-cycle amount and availability need confirmation.
funding.applicationCycle: School scholarship applications usually open for about 30 days around November 1 for spring and April 1 for fall. Confirm the actual upcoming window in Mav ScholarShop.
funding.nextStep: Consider this only if UTA is a school option. After admission, complete the Mav ScholarShop general application and Social Work application; confirm online-cohort eligibility.

other: Preference includes first-generation students, single parents, students overcoming obstacles, and those whose education was interrupted.

other_requirements: Award availability and eligibility for the intended online MSW cohort must be confirmed with UTA.
